Below is a list of companies having stocks that are included in the '''S&P MidCap 400''' ('''[[S&P 400]]''') [[stock market index]]. The index, maintained by [[S&P Dow Jones Indices]], comprises the common stocks of 400 [[market capitalization|mid-cap]], mostly American, companies. Although called the S&P 400, the index sometimes contains more than 400 stocks when it includes two or more share classes of stock from one of its component companies.
